extDescription.message: Summarize the page you are reading, or the text you have selected, with your Inkling account.

setupText.message: Add your Inkling address and an API key to start. You make a key on your account page.

keepLabel.message: Keep it in my Inkling library

stoppedNote.message: Stopped. This is what was written so far.

cannotRead.message: Inkling cannot read this kind of page (for example a browser settings page or the Chrome Web Store). Open a normal web page and try again.

noText.message: There is no text on this page to summarize.

allowTitle.message: Allow access to your Inkling server

allowText.message: The extension needs your permission to talk to $HOST$.

permissionDenied.message: Without that permission the extension cannot reach your Inkling server.

errNetwork.message: Could not reach $HOST$. Check the address in the settings and your connection.

errInvalidKey.message: The API key was not accepted. Check it in the settings, or make a new one on your Inkling account page.

errExpiredKey.message: This API key has expired. Make a new one on your Inkling account page.

errKeyLimit.message: This key has used its daily limit. It resets at midnight UTC.

errQuota.message: Your daily allowance is used up. It resets at midnight UTC.

errRateLimit.message: Too many requests. Wait $COUNT$ seconds and try again.

errRateLimitSoon.message: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.

errTooLarge.message: This page has too much text to summarize in one go. Select the part you want and try again.

errPaused.message: Inkling has paused summaries for today. Try again later.

errAi.message: The summary could not be made right now. Try again in a moment.

errBadRequest.message: Inkling did not accept this request: $MESSAGE$

addressHint.message: The web address of your Inkling server, for example https://api.example.com. Plain http is only allowed for localhost.

keyHint.message: Make one on your Inkling account page. It is kept in this browser only and sent only to the address above.

testOk.message: Connected. Key “$NAME$”: $USED$ of $LIMIT$ requests used today.

errAddress.message: Enter a valid address that starts with https:// (http:// works only for localhost).

errKeyFormat.message: An Inkling API key starts with ink_.

privacyText.message: The text of the page (or your selection) is sent to the Inkling address above when you press the button, and nowhere else. Nothing is read in the background, and nothing is sent until you ask.

savedLater.message: Saved to your reading list, with a short summary.

alreadySavedLater.message: That page is already on your reading list.

errListFull.message: Your reading list is full. Remove or archive some items on the Inkling website first.

explainNote.message: This is the AI's explanation. It can be wrong, so check anything that matters.

explainClipped.message: Only the first $COUNT$ characters were explained.
